## CPF product change

- [ ] Owner Module and actual Consumer are identified.
- [ ] Public API, customer Extension SPI, and Internal implementation boundaries are explicit.
- [ ] No reverse/circular dependency or external Internal-package reference is introduced.
- [ ] A new Starter/Capability entry includes its Value Contract, convenience API, extension SPI or a justified N/A, actual Consumer, removal-alternative comparison, footprint, and Runtime Evidence plan.
- [ ] Generated Domain/Profile/Capability/Provider resolution and resolved lock remain reproducible.
- [ ] Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB impacts are aligned where DB objects or queries change.
- [ ] Normal, error, boundary, partial-failure, UNKNOWN, retry, recovery, and multi-instance behavior are tested as applicable.
- [ ] Security, authorization, audit, masking, secret handling, and operations controls were reviewed.
- [ ] `qualityGate` and relevant Runtime/environment gates were run once and exact commands/results are linked.
- [ ] No protected path, secret, build output, temporary evidence, or duplicate QA document is included.
